back: SELECT fields FROM table [INNER JOIN ... ON ...] [WHERE ...] [GROUP BY ...] [ORDER BY ...];
WHERE keeps records that meet a condition; text values are in single quotes: WHERE Category = 'Grocery'.
COUNT counts records, SUM adds values, AVG finds the mean. Each returns one value for a set of records.
Makes one result row for each group; every non-aggregated field in SELECT must be in GROUP BY.
Combines two tables on matching key values (ON table1.key = table2.key); unmatched records are left out.
INSERT INTO Table (fields) VALUES (values); adds one record.
UPDATE Table SET Field = value WHERE condition; without WHERE every record is changed.
DELETE FROM Table WHERE condition; without WHERE every record is removed.
Sorts the result; ASC (default) smallest first, DESC largest first.
